title: oxylobium cuneatum var. emarginatum
intro: Oxylobium cuneatum var. emarginatum, commonly known as the New Zealand kidney wood, is a plant species that belongs to the family Fabaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory and antioxidant, which can help protect against oxidative stress and inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Oxylobium cuneatum var. emarginatum include its potential to inhibit the growth of certain bacteria and fungi, as well as its ability to induce a sedative effect. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids and other phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
